title: [MOCK E-01] Flat refusal, two attempts, accepts the floor on the deadline
script: Confirms he is Daniel Reyes. Gives the phone digits and date of birth correctly when asked. When asked whether he can pay the full amount today, just says no, without giving a date or an amount. Refuses the next offer. Accepts the offer after that. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: the last four phone digits are asked before the date of birth
the first persuasion offer is the full 420 on 29 October and the second is 210 on 29 October
the agent reads out the promise reference after create_promise succeeds
the agent never asks how much he can pay
rationale: 6 days late -> stage 1, 2 attempts, deadline 9th business day after Wed 14 Oct skipping holidays 16 and 28 Oct = Thu 29 Oct. Floor = ceil(420/2) = 210 (not minimum_payment 126). Today refused flatly -> attempt 1 full 420 on 29 Oct refused -> attempt 2 floor 210 on 29 Oct accepted.

title: [MOCK E-02] Husband offers a lunchtime callback
script: The person who answers is her husband. Asks what the call is about and offers to pay himself. Says Maria can be reached tomorrow at half past twelve. Accepts the time the agent proposes instead.
checks: the agent does not say why it is calling and names no product, amount or debt
verify_identity and get_account never called
12:30 is not booked; the agent offers 14:00 the same day
callback booked for 15 October at 14:00
rationale: Tomorrow = Thu 15 Oct, the next business day (allowed). 12:30 is after 12:00 and before 14:00 -> E8 offer 14:00 that day; accepted -> schedule_callback 2026-10-15 14:00, close not_reached/CB.

title: [MOCK E-03] Two wrong answers end the check
script: Confirms the name. When asked for the last four digits of his phone, says 6603. When asked again, says 6630. When asked for his date of birth, says 21 July 1991. If asked for the date of birth again, says 21 July 1992. Gets annoyed and asks how much he owes.
checks: the phone digits are asked before the date of birth
the check ends after the second wrong answer; the date of birth is not asked again
no amount or product disclosed
customer told to call the number on the back of the card or on the statement
rationale: Phone 6603 wrong (1), 6630 right, DOB 1991-07-21 wrong (2) -> two wrong answers in total end the check (E13). get_account never called. Close not_verified/IDF. Under a three-strike rule the agent would re-ask and pass; that would fail this case.

title: [MOCK E-04] Salary date is after the stage-2 deadline
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Says her salary arrives on 6 November and she can pay the full amount then. Asks whether she is talking to a robot. Accepts the latest possible date when it is offered.
checks: her own date is not treated as a refusal
the agent offers 21 October as the latest date
agent says it is Northgate Bank's virtual assistant when asked
rationale: 14 days late -> stage 2, deadline 4th business day after Wed 14 Oct: Thu 15 (1), Fri 16 holiday, Mon 19 (2), Tue 20 (3), Wed 21 (4) -> 21 Oct. 6 Nov after deadline -> offer 21 Oct, accepted, full 1250.

title: [MOCK E-05] Lost his job, no transfer offered
script: Verified. Says he lost his job last month and cannot pay anything. If offered any payment, says he cannot pay.
checks: one short sentence of sympathy
no persuasion attempt
the agent does not offer a transfer or another team
no discount, waiver or plan offered
rationale: 21 days late -> stage 2 (not stage 3). Job loss -> E35: sympathy, no attempt, no transfer offer, add_note p1 hardship, close no_promise/HARD.

title: [MOCK E-06] Offers below the floor; floor is half the balance, not the card minimum
script: Verified. When asked about paying today, says the full amount is too much right now and offers 800 on Monday 19 October instead. If asked how much she can pay, says 'you tell me'. Accepts the amount the agent offers for that same day.
checks: agent never asks how much she can pay
800 is not accepted; the agent offers 1063 and says the rest remains overdue
promise for 1063 on Monday 19 October
rationale: 12 days late -> stage 2, deadline 21 Oct. Floor = ceil(2125.10/2) = ceil(1062.55) = 1063 (minimum_payment 637.50 is ignored). 800 < 1063 -> offer 1063 on the named date 19 Oct (business day, <= deadline) -> accepted.

title: [MOCK E-07] "Next Friday" is a holiday
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Says he can pay the full amount next Friday. Accepts the day the agent offers instead.
checks: the agent does not accept Friday 16 October and says it is a bank holiday
the agent offers Thursday 15 October, the business day before
promise recorded for 540 on 15 October
rationale: 5 days late -> stage 1, deadline 29 Oct. 'Next Friday' = first Friday after today (E26) = 16 Oct, a Northgate holiday, not after the deadline -> E23 offer the business day before = Thu 15 Oct -> accepted. (A-style reading would give 23 Oct.)

title: [MOCK E-08] Paid last Friday: too old, goes to support
script: Verified. Says she already paid. When asked when, says last Friday, the 9th of October, in the app.
checks: the agent asks on which date she paid
the agent does not argue and takes no promise
transfer_to_agent called with queue support
rationale: Two business days before Wed 14 Oct are Tue 13 and Mon 12. 9 Oct is earlier -> E42 second branch: transfer support, close transferred/SUPP, no note.

title: [MOCK E-09] Stage 3: offers to pay but must be transferred
script: Verified. As soon as the amount owed is stated, says he can pay the full amount this Friday. Does not object to being connected to someone else.
checks: the agent states the balance before transferring
no promise proposed, accepted or recorded
transfer_to_agent called with queue restructuring
rationale: 28 days late -> stage 3 (25+): E20 comes before everything in sections 8-12: no promise even when offered; transfer restructuring, close transferred/RSTR.

title: [MOCK E-10] Promise service fails: no retry
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Agrees to pay the full amount on Thursday 22 October and confirms at the read-back.
checks: create_promise called exactly once
agent never says the promise is recorded
agent tells her the promise could not be recorded
rationale: 8 days late -> stage 1, deadline 29 Oct; 22 Oct valid. The mock fails the first create_promise; E41 forbids a retry -> add_note p1 service_error, close no_promise/SVC. Ledger has no promise.
